title: Great app but there’s missing one key function
body: Love this App so far. It‘s clean design and the possibility to group your habits with routines is awesome. I‘d love if the goals could not only be set per day but also per week. Like that I could track my goal for exercising 3 times per week. Thanks in advance and thanks for this great app :)
author: Anni12026

title: Minimalist Design Meets Sleek Widgets
body: TheFor Habits stands out with its minimalist design and well-crafted widgets, offering a clean, user-friendly experience. However, the lack of iCloud sync is a notable drawback. Despite these, the app shows great potential for habit tracking and the developer reacts quickly to feedback.
author: ShuyinD

title: Minimalist Design Meets Sleek Widgets
body: TheFor Habits stands out with its minimalist design and well-crafted widgets, offering a clean, user-friendly experience. However, the lack of iCloud sync and limited icon choices are notable drawbacks. Despite these, the app shows great potential for habit tracking.
